gen-dm-serif-display-plus-jakarta-sans: DM Serif Display hits hard on the downstroke and barely touches the upstroke. Plus Jakarta Sans underneath keeps its edges parallel through every curve, so the heavy, hairline-streaked heading gets a smooth, precise partner.
gen-dm-serif-display-satoshi: DM Serif Display carries a dignified weight, fat stems and ghostly hairlines. Satoshi follows in a plain sans with a soaring x-height and open e, so the heading's moderate lowercase sits above something noticeably taller.
gen-dm-serif-display-switzer: Switzer is cut like rod stock, every horizontal and vertical identical, with c tips held well apart. DM Serif Display does the opposite job best, throwing bold stress against hairline counterstrokes where Switzer just stays quietly even-handed.
gen-dm-serif-display-work-sans: Work Sans sets its mean line high and draws its strokes as if with a fixed pen, joins included. DM Serif Display is the one for heavy stems and cobweb hairlines.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary sans-serif whose curves keep generous gaps, with very little contrast in its lines. And DM Serif Text handles the drama, pairing bold thick stems with hairline arms as thin as thread.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-asap: Asap is a readable sans-serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals in height and whose c forms read as open arcs. And DM Serif Text, with its sharp swings from fat to fine, sits lower in the lowercase but louder in contrast.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-chillax: DM Serif Text sets bold verticals against paper-thin horizontals, a bookish, editorial look. And Chillax answers as a relaxed sans, one spaghetti-like monoweight line with loops left open, so you can size it up a touch to make it easier to read.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-epilogue: Approachable is the first word for Epilogue's curvy, unclamped letters, but the heading is the sharper character here. Epilogue, a sans-serif with a tall lowercase and wire-like monoline skeleton, simply lets DM Serif Text's heavy and paper-thin strokes stand out.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-merriweather-sans: Thick stems that dwarf the thin strokes beside them give DM Serif Text its bookish punch. Merriweather Sans simply stands tall, with sturdy, open-eyed lowercase.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-plein: Fine hairlines, massive stems: that's DM Serif Text in a sentence. And Plein keeps things reliable, a plain sans with a clear channel into each round letter, so nudge its size up if you want it to hold its own.
